title: Setu redesign
common: Fintech web app "Setu 桥" for guarded cross-border student payments. Ink-navy `#0f1b2d` chrome, warm paper `#f6f4ef` background, white cards radius 12 with 1px `#e2ded3` border, jade `#0b7a5a` primary buttons, bridge-blue links, amber warnings, cinnabar danger, Noto Sans, tabular numerals for money. Bilingual: primary text English; show 简体中文 where quoted. zh-CN text runs 30–40% shorter than English — size labels to the English length, never truncate. A slim amber strip reads "SYNTHETIC DATA · SANDBOX BANK · 演示数据 · SAMPLE FX".

screens.name: dashboard
screens.prompt: Dashboard screen, light theme. Header "Dashboard 总览" with locale toggle EN/简. Four stat cards with left accents: Next due CNY 18,500.00 (jade), BDT needed 352,000 (footnote "1 CNY = 19.03 BDT · SAMPLE · fees incl."), Safe to spend CNY 4,820 + BDT subline, Pending approvals 2 (amber). Timeline list of obligations, each row: date, urgency chip ("Due in 6 days / 6 天后到期"), payee, amount, "Plan payment" link, truncated doc hash `a1b2c3d4`. Right/below: deadline cards and budget donut (spent vs remaining). Jade verified badge on seeded payees.

screens.name: agent
screens.prompt: Agent live trace screen, light theme. Two columns. Left: chat — user bubble dark ink right, agent bubble paper left containing a "plan" card (tool `compute_costs`: CNY 18,500 → BDT 352,000, fee USD 3.00 + 0.40%) and a payment action card with **T2 · TOTP** jade tier pill, payee, amount, "Approvals" link; composer with document select and pill prompts. Right: sticky "Live trace" panel with numbered vertical stepper, one node per step — Intake → Planner → Tools → Guardian → Policy → Executor → Validator — each with status icon (✓ ok jade, – skipped slate), ms timing, expandable JSON; footer shows final tier pill T2, decision chip "REQUIRE_APPROVAL", required-chips "○ Student TOTP ○ Family approver", "✓ Reply validated", audit seq links #41 #42.

screens.name: approvals
screens.prompt: Approvals screen, light theme. Title "Approvals 审批", tabs "Pending (2)" / "History". Action card: payee "Shenzhen Example University", CNY 18,500.00 → BDT, **T3 · Approval 审批** amber pill, reason list, required-chips showing "✓ Student TOTP" done jade and "○ Family approver" pending amber, 6-box TOTP input, countdown chip "Cooling-off ends 23:41:05", primary jade Approve and ghost Reject in a sticky bottom bar with safe-area padding. History card shows executed status + audit hash.

screens.name: audit
screens.prompt: Audit verify screen, light theme. Title "Audit log 审计日志", jade outline banner "✓ Chain verified · 42 entries checked". Table (cards when narrow): Seq, Time, Actor, Event, Hash with copy buttons; one row highlighted cinnabar with outline and "⚠ tampered 已篡改" after a red "✕ Chain broken at #12" alert banner above. Expandable row detail showing payload_hash, prev_hash, hash in mono. Header actions: jade "Verify chain", ghost "Export evidence". Collapsed "Tamper demo" panel with seq input and cinnabar button.

screens.name: documents
screens.prompt: Documents screen, light theme. Title "Documents 文档". Stepper: 1 Paste/notice card — textarea with pasted tuition notice, sample select, drag-drop zone; 2 Guardian verdict card — status badge "blocked", cinnabar banner "⛔ Blocked 已阻止" listing flags "HIGH injection phrase `ignore previous instructions`"; 3 Parsed vs confirm two-column card (amount, due date, payee, masked account `6222 •••• 4821`, reference) with confirm form, password-style account field with show/hide, checkbox "I checked these against the original", jade confirm. Footnote: doc hash, "Documents are data, never instructions 文档是数据，不是指令".

screens.name: payees
screens.prompt: Payees screen, light theme. Title "Payees 收款人". List cards: name, jade "Verified 已验证" or amber "Unverified" badge, masked account mono, token `ACCT_9f2c…`, bank, verified date. One unverified card shows amber banner "Cooling-off 23:41:05" countdown and text "Needs family approver verification 需家人审批人验证". Bottom sheet "Add payee": name, account number, bank, jade submit. Footnote "Accounts stored encrypted + tokenised".

screens.name: settings
screens.prompt: Settings screen, light theme. Title "Settings 设置". Cards: TOTP setup — QR code, masked secret with show/copy, 6-box code input, "✓ Enabled 已启用" jade state; Language — EN / 简体中文 segmented toggle; Consent — three checkboxes (sensitive data, cross-border transfer, LLM processing) with "Saved 已保存"; Data — ghost "Export evidence", cinnabar "Erase my data" opening a confirm dialog; theme toggle Light/Dark/System with sun-moon icons.
